name: Andrefana Dry Forests
description: In western Madagascar, the Andrefana Dry Forests protect a string of wild landscapes, from razor-sharp limestone "tsingy" spires and the deep Manambolo river canyon to mangroves, lakes and spiny thickets. Rare lemurs and birds live here, along with baobabs and flame trees. Among them are ancient bird lineages, one of which dates back 54 million years.
